milestone: ATTR58: genuine uninitialized backing for pure block GET and short SET
status: Independently accepted bounded implementation; wider hooks and full core remain partial
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; project-local binary and tests/semantics/profile.json

production.scope: The same ordinary parentless CLASS public typed pure block GET/index 0 and short SET/index 1 pair now accepts an ABSENT property initializer. Its real descriptor is PROP_UNINITIALIZED and its physical backing slot stays PROP_INITIAL until a successful implicit write. The actual short SET proves backing independently of GET/body/default. Header arguments for property name/initializer are obsolete and removed; current callers and the maintained ATTR57 fixture migrate to the two-hook predicate. No new runtime/default/type/storage formula, Trait/byref/attribute/parameter-default/header, schema/task or Tick expansion.

authority.source: Zend/zend_compile.c: zend_property_hook_uses_property makes every short SET inherently backed and zend_property_is_virtual folds all actual hooks. zend_compile_property_hooks shares prop_info and rewrites short SET to this property's implicit assignment. Zend/zend_object_handlers.c: zend_should_call_hook lets the active matching SET read its backing, while zend_std_read_property reports a typed uninitialized read. Existing type reception, typed backing writes, hook return and receiver cleanup supply all runtime behavior.

Both GET and SET RHS have no syntactic own-backing use. Physical GET 0/SET 1, distinct signatures, actual typed Param and source pair authenticate backing. independent_review: CLEAR for bounded semantics, raw ABSENT/genuine uninitialized backing, read/type/write timing, actual source/slot/owners/abrupt state, resumption, maintained-fixture migration, harness, documentation and inventory.
compatibility: The old initialized/own-backing header condition is removed because any admitted short SET supplies backing. The existing initialized pure GET compiler certificate still requires its real explicit initializer; an uninitialized GET already uses its genuine PROP_UNINITIALIZED compile guard. Authentic paired origins already defeat getter-only virtual classification from ATTR57, so ordinary slot allocation/read/write/type/cleanup rules are reused unchanged. The maintained ATTR57 front has only its two retained header calls migrated and obsolete ABSENT refusal removed; its original 148-condition report/hash remain frozen. New ATTR58 source and initial-slot evidence validate the promoted domain. No ATTR57 or older campaign was replayed.
